style: Chunky cartoon illustration in the style of a modern children's activity book cover. Thick uniform black outlines (4-6px), bold flat saturated colors, simple cel-shading with one darker tone per surface, no gradients, no airbrush, no photorealism. Big round expressive eyes with a single white highlight, tiny pink blush cheeks, friendly smile. Chubby rounded proportions. Cozy warm indoor or outdoor scene with detailed props: potted plants, wooden furniture, mugs, food, checkered fabrics, cozy rugs, windows with blue sky and clouds. Palette: warm cream and butter yellow walls, wood browns, leafy green, red gingham accents, blue sky, purple and blue rugs. Composition: character centered filling most of the frame with environment visible around them. Black rectangular border frame around the whole image. No text, no logos, no watermarks. High detail, print-quality.
